# KroxIT Solutions

> KroxIT provides managed IT services, IT support, networking, security, server and cloud infrastructure, and laptop/desktop repair for businesses across Mohali, Zirakpur, Chandigarh and Panchkula (Chandigarh Tricity), including the IT City Sector 82 and IT Park corridors in Mohali.

KroxIT works with offices, startups, schools, hospitals, hotels, warehouses, manufacturing units and retail businesses. Services are delivered on-site by certified engineers, with Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) covering scheduled audits, preventive maintenance, patching and priority SLA response.

## Services

- [IT Services Overview](https://kroxit.com/services.html): Networking, firewalls, CCTV, biometric access, server & cloud services, laptop repair and AMC.
- [Networking & Office LAN Setup](https://kroxit.com/networking-services.html): Structured cabling, VLAN segmentation, managed switching, fibre backbone and mesh Wi-Fi installation.
- [Laptop & Desktop Repair](https://kroxit.com/local-repair.html): Doorstep repair with certified engineers, genuine parts and warranty.
- [Server & Cloud Services](https://kroxit.com/server-cloud-services.html): Server installation, hardware repair, data centre setup, cloud migration and backup.
- [AMC Plans](https://kroxit.com/amc.html): Annual maintenance contracts with scheduled audits, preventive replacement and priority SLA response.

## Company

- [Contact](https://kroxit.com/contact.html): Phone, WhatsApp, email and a contact form.
- [Book a Consultation](https://kroxit.com/book.html): Free on-site IT consultation booking.

## Service area

Mohali, Zirakpur, Chandigarh, Panchkula, IT City Sector 82 (Mohali), IT Park (Mohali), and the wider Chandigarh Tricity.
